title: Institute of Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences
content:
The Institute of Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences (ICCAS), founded in 1956 in Beijing, is a national research institute covering polymer science, physical chemistry, organic and molecular sciences, and advanced materials. It hosts the CAS Key Laboratory of Engineering Plastics and the Laboratory of Polymer Physics and Chemistry, among other research divisions.

ICCAS researchers have published influential aerogel work: the group of Jian Xu and Ning Zhao created superelastic polyimide nanofiber aerogels for thermal insulation and PM2.5 filtration, and fire-resistant polybenzazole (PBO) aerogels with ultralow density, thermal conductivity of 26-38 mW/m·K, and a 350 °C long-term use temperature. Other teams developed cellulose-based superhygroscopic aerogels for humidity control, with relevance to energy-efficient buildings, aerospace, and environmental applications.
